Your attachment style,
as a little plush
strings.ui.waitingSubtitle: Different little hearts, all worth loving.
strings.ui.aboutBrief: It's your way of connecting with someone close. Meet the two sides of attachment—anxiety and avoidance—as a little plush.
strings.ui.faqTimeA: Just answer 16 everyday situations. Your plush is about 3 minutes away!
strings.ui.faqChangeA: Yes. Attachment can change with relationship experiences. You may also be different in love and in friendship.
strings.ui.faqPairA: Send a red-thread invitation from your result. We'll connect two plushies drawn in the same mode.
strings.ui.faqPrivacyA: No login. Your records stay on this device. Shared links contain scores, mode, scoring version and your optional nickname.

strings.ui.aboutModes: Love and friendship modes use different situations but the same scoring rules. Attachment can change with relationship experiences.

strings.ui.aboutHelp: Support in South Korea: youth counseling 1388 · suicide prevention counseling 109. Elsewhere, check your local counseling or emergency support services.
strings.ui.disclaimer: A self-discovery test just for fun, not a medical or psychological diagnosis. Attachment can change with relationship experiences.
strings.ui.privacyTitle: Where do my heart's records live?
strings.ui.privacyBody: Answers, results, your collection, friends and language preference are stored on this device. There is no server account or cross-device syncing. Resetting removes this device's test records, but cannot revoke links already shared. No external analytics or advertising services are connected in this app. Sharing an image or link to another app is subject to that service's policies.
strings.ui.termsBody: This is an entertainment test for self-understanding, not a substitute for professional counseling or diagnosis. Results can change with relationship experiences, and appearance rates are estimates. Shared links are neither certificates nor a way to identify a person. Final operating policies and contact details will be confirmed before release.

strings.q.Q01.love: Your KakaoTalk message to that person has stayed unread for three hours.
strings.q.Q01.friend: Your KakaoTalk message to your best friend has stayed unread for three hours.
strings.q.Q01.option0: Must be busy. Phone down, back to my own stuff.
strings.q.Q01.option1: I check now and then when it crosses my mind.
strings.q.Q01.option2: I reread what I sent. Did I say something wrong…?
strings.q.Q01.option3: I've already finished three imaginary stories about us drifting apart.
strings.q.Q02.love: On a night walk, they say, ‘Can we talk about how we've been feeling lately?’
strings.q.Q02.friend: Late at night, your best friend says, ‘Can we have a serious heart-to-heart?’
strings.q.Q02.option0: Yes! I've got plenty to say, too.
strings.q.Q02.option1: A bit shy, but I give talking a try.
strings.q.Q02.option2: I want to joke, ‘Whoa, where did that come from?’ and brush it off.
strings.q.Q02.option3: I want to escape. I already feel suffocated.
strings.q.Q03.love: They usually flood you with stickers, but today the reply is just ‘yep.’
strings.q.Q03.friend: Your usually super-expressive best friend replies with only ‘yep’ today.
strings.q.Q03.option0: Probably tired. I'll ask if they're okay later.
strings.q.Q03.option1: It bothers me a little, then I forget about it.
strings.q.Q03.option2: I scroll back through our chat. Did I do something wrong?
strings.q.Q03.option3: I'm sure they've lost interest and feel hurt all on my own.
strings.q.Q04.love: They say, ‘Let's call every night before bed!’
strings.q.Q04.friend: Your best friend says, ‘Let's share our day every night before bed!’
strings.q.Q04.option0: Love it. It feels like a lovely way to end the day.
strings.q.Q04.option1: Sounds nice, though I'd want a break sometimes.
strings.q.Q04.option2: Every day feels like a lot. I'm already thinking of excuses.
strings.q.Q04.option3: Even imagining it is tiring. Where did my own time go?
strings.q.Q05.love: Their story shows them having a great time with people you don't know.
strings.q.Q05.friend: Your best friend's story shows them hanging out with other friends—without you.
strings.q.Q05.option0: Looks fun! I tap the heart and move on.
strings.q.Q05.option1: Who are they? Briefly curious, then I move on.
strings.q.Q05.option2: They look happier than when they're with me, so I start comparing.
strings.q.Q05.option3: So they're fine without me… I feel down for the whole day.
strings.q.Q06.love: You're sick in bed all day. They ask, ‘Do you need anything?’
strings.q.Q06.friend: You're sick in bed all day. Your best friend asks, ‘Shall I bring you some porridge?’
strings.q.Q06.option0: ‘Yes, please come!’ I honestly ask for help.
strings.q.Q06.option1: I feel bad and decline once, but eventually ask.
strings.q.Q06.option2: ‘I'm fine, really!’ I handle it on my own.
strings.q.Q06.option3: I didn't even tell them. I don't want to show I'm unwell.
strings.q.Q07.love: After an argument, they say, ‘I need some time to think.’
strings.q.Q07.friend: After a little disagreement, your best friend says, ‘I'll sort my thoughts out and get back to you.’
strings.q.Q07.option0: Okay, let's talk when you're ready. I'll do my own things while I wait.
strings.q.Q07.option1: I'm a little anxious, but I wait for them to reach out.
strings.q.Q07.option2: I can't keep waiting, so I send, ‘Are you still upset?’
strings.q.Q07.option3: I keep writing and deleting a long message, scared this could be the end.
strings.q.Q08.love: Saying ‘I like you’ to that person feels…
strings.q.Q08.friend: Saying ‘You really matter to me’ to your best friend feels…
strings.q.Q08.option0: Natural. If I think it, I say it.
strings.q.Q08.option1: A little embarrassing sometimes, but I say what I need to.
strings.q.Q08.option2: I feel it but can't get the words out. I show it through actions.
strings.q.Q08.option3: So awkward I practically can't do it.
strings.q.Q09.love: How often do you want reassurance about how much they like you?
strings.q.Q09.friend: How often do you want reassurance about how much your best friend cares?
strings.q.Q09.option0: Hardly ever. I can feel it without checking.
strings.q.Q09.option1: Sometimes, but a few words are enough.
strings.q.Q09.option2: Often. I need to ask directly and hear the answer to relax.
strings.q.Q09.option3: Even after an answer, I'm anxious. I analyze their tone all over again.
strings.q.Q10.love: Whenever things get hard, they lean on you for support.
strings.q.Q10.friend: Whenever things get hard, your best friend tells you first.
strings.q.Q10.option0: I like feeling that they trust me.
strings.q.Q10.option1: I like it, but sometimes it's a lot to carry.
strings.q.Q10.option2: I feel responsible and want to step back a little.
strings.q.Q10.option3: Having someone rely on me feels especially overwhelming.
strings.q.Q11.love: They cancel a date you've been looking forward to the day before, saying something urgent came up.
strings.q.Q11.friend: Your best friend cancels plans you've been looking forward to the day before, saying something urgent came up.
strings.q.Q11.option0: Disappointing, but we can meet another day! I suggest a new date.
strings.q.Q11.option1: A little disappointed, but I understand.
strings.q.Q11.option2: Is it really urgent… or do they just not feel like seeing me?
strings.q.Q11.option3: So I'm not a priority after all. My hurt feelings are about to spill over.
strings.q.Q12.love: They ask, ‘What do you think we'll be doing a year from now?’ and start talking about the distant future.
strings.q.Q12.friend: Your best friend says, ‘Let's live together someday! And travel every year!’
strings.q.Q12.option0: I get excited and make plans with them.
strings.q.Q12.option1: It's nice, but far away, so I just smile and listen.
strings.q.Q12.option2: It feels like promising the future, so I start backing away a little.
strings.q.Q12.option3: It weighs on me. I change the subject right away.
strings.q.Q13.love: If you showed them every part of the real you…
strings.q.Q13.friend: If you showed your best friend every part of the real you…
strings.q.Q13.option0: I think they'd like me just as much as now.
strings.q.Q13.option1: Things might change a little, but I think it'd be okay.
strings.q.Q13.option2: I only show my better sides, worried I'd disappoint them.
strings.q.Q13.option3: Just imagining it scares me. I think they'd eventually leave.
strings.q.Q14.love: You're spending the whole weekend together. By the second evening, you…
strings.q.Q14.friend: You're on a three-day trip with your best friend. By the second evening, you…
strings.q.Q14.option0: Still love it. Being together feels comfortable.
strings.q.Q14.option1: Am a little tired, but having fun.
strings.q.Q14.option2: Desperately need alone time. I pretend to go to the store and take a walk.
strings.q.Q14.option3: Am completely drained. I just want to go home and be alone.
strings.q.Q15.love: They've really gotten into a new hobby lately and spend less time with you.
strings.q.Q15.friend: Your best friend has become close with new friends lately and spends less time with you.
strings.q.Q15.option0: Good for them for finding something fun! I enjoy my own time, too.
strings.q.Q15.option1: It feels a little empty, but I soon adjust.
strings.q.Q15.option2: Do they like that more than me…? My hurt starts showing.
strings.q.Q15.option3: I feel like I'm being forgotten, so I contact them more often.
strings.q.Q16.love: They ask, ‘Is something worrying you lately?’ There actually is something.
strings.q.Q16.friend: Your best friend asks, ‘Something's been going on, hasn't it?’ There actually is something.
strings.q.Q16.option0: I open up as if I've been waiting for them to ask.
strings.q.Q16.option1: I hesitate a little, then tell them.
strings.q.Q16.option2: ‘No, nothing much!’ I keep it to myself.
strings.q.Q16.option3: Talking about worries itself feels uncomfortable, so I change the subject.
strings.t.P01.name: Secure Puppy
strings.t.P01.nick: A tail that wags with trust
strings.t.P01.quote: A late reply is fine. We're still us!
strings.t.P01.extra1: I'll use words, not my tail, when I'm hurt.
strings.t.P01.intro: Trusting close people comes naturally to this plush. If messages slow down, it thinks ‘They must be busy,’ and talks through hurt feelings instead of storing them up. Somehow, being around this person helps your heart relax.
strings.t.P01.charm0: A bad mood doesn't become an attitude
strings.t.P01.charm1: Says thank you and sorry right away
strings.t.P01.trigger1: Tired when always doing the adapting
strings.t.P01.care1: Gently rinse out hurt feelings each day
strings.t.P01.care2: A sunny walk leaves me fluffy
strings.t.P01.care3: No games that test my trust
strings.t.P01.tip: Secure hearts can get tired, too. Don't always be the understanding one; try saying what you need first.
strings.t.P01.best: A steady wag is the best reassurance for a worried bunny
strings.t.P01.tricky: When the waiting drags on, even this tail droops
strings.t.P02.name: Secure Penguin
strings.t.P02.nick: A sweetheart with a pebble for you
strings.t.P02.quote: I picked this up thinking of you. It's nothing, hehe.
strings.t.P02.extra0: Winter isn't cold when we're huddled together.
strings.t.P02.extra1: How was your day? Tell me every little bit!
strings.t.P02.intro: This plush shows affection often through little actions. It's happiest huddling close to someone it likes, and reaches out first even after a disagreement. When affection grows quieter, though, it has a cute tendency to look a little gloomy.
strings.t.P02.charm0: Remembers and cares for the little details
strings.t.P02.charm1: Knows how to reach out first after a fight
strings.t.P02.trigger0: When its affection gets no response
strings.t.P02.trigger1: When only it remembers a special day
strings.t.P02.care2: Don't forget a gift you received
strings.t.P02.care3: Give thanks one extra rinse in words
strings.t.P02.care4: Smooth hurt feelings with a lukewarm talk
strings.t.P02.tip: Practice receiving as well as giving. Saying ‘I need this, too’ isn't a burden—it's another kind of gift.
strings.t.P02.best: An affectionate penguin and a relaxed capybara have just the right temperature difference
strings.t.P02.tricky: The closer the penguin comes, the further the turtle retreats
strings.t.P03.name: Secure Capybara
strings.t.P03.nick: Calm with a tangerine on top
strings.t.P03.quote: Together is nice. Apart is nice, too. Peace~
strings.t.P03.extra0: No rush. Let's take our time.
strings.t.P03.extra1: Angry? Nope, just thinking about hot springs.
strings.t.P03.intro: This plush has room to breathe in relationships. Time together and time alone are equally precious, and most things don't shake it. It gets along comfortably with almost anyone, so people gather around it naturally.
strings.t.P03.charm1: Respects the other person's own time
strings.t.P03.trigger0: Being told it's hard to read
strings.t.P03.trigger1: Being repeatedly pushed to express feelings
strings.t.P03.care0: Wash at a lukewarm hot-spring temperature
strings.t.P03.care3: Sometimes rinse with an ‘I like you’ first
strings.t.P03.care4: Gently smooth hurt hidden under calmness
strings.t.P03.tip: Your calm can sometimes look like indifference. Even when everything is fine, let them know with an occasional ‘I'm happy right now.’
strings.t.P03.best: The capybara's back is the duckling's favorite spot
strings.t.P03.tricky: The tiger may read a calm face as not caring
strings.t.P04.name: Secure Otter
strings.t.P04.quote: I'll hold your hand so we don't drift away.
strings.t.P04.extra0: I need time to open clams alone, too. Back soon!
strings.t.P04.extra1: We're okay, right? Yes, I know we are.
strings.t.P04.intro: This plush balances closeness and independence well. It enjoys playing alone but wants to hold hands when falling asleep. Sometimes it needs reassurance, yet it's also quite good at soothing its own heart.
strings.t.P04.charm0: Finds a comfortable amount of space
strings.t.P04.charm1: Honestly leans on others when needed
strings.t.P04.trigger1: When alone time hurts someone's feelings
strings.t.P04.care0: Light daily wash with a hello
strings.t.P04.care1: Air dry during your separate time
strings.t.P04.care2: No letting go and drifting away
strings.t.P04.tip: You're good at comforting yourself. Trust that strength, but don't swallow everything alone. Sometimes ask, ‘Could you hold my hand?’
strings.t.P04.best: It gently takes the hand of a cat pretending to be cool
strings.t.P04.tricky: An otter is startled when the pufferfish puffs up as it reaches out
strings.t.P05.name: Anxious Duckling
strings.t.P05.quote: Where are you going? I'll come! I just… want to be together.
strings.t.P05.extra0: From the moment we met, I decided to follow only you.
strings.t.P05.extra1: I didn't count the minutes until your reply. Really.
strings.t.P05.intro: This plush follows the person it cares about everywhere. It can't hide its affection, so it usually reaches out and expresses feelings first. That also means even a slightly cooler response quickly weighs on its heart, leaving it wanting reassurance.
strings.t.P05.charm1: Notices even small changes in others
strings.t.P05.trigger0: Feeling like it's the only one who cares more
strings.t.P05.care0: Please rinse with a reply within 20 minutes
strings.t.P05.care1: Wash with an ‘I missed you, too’
strings.t.P05.care3: A reassurance net is essential in new places
strings.t.P05.care4: Listen to my whole story for a fluffy finish
strings.t.P05.tip: The more you follow someone, the smaller your own steps can become. Today, put one thing you like first—not just what they like.
strings.t.P05.best: The capybara's back is the duckling's comfiest place
strings.t.P05.tricky: The duckling gets lost during the panda's bamboo time
strings.t.P06.name: Anxious Bunny
strings.t.P06.quote: If you've read it, reply… No, it's fine… No, it isn't.
strings.t.P06.extra0: If you're fine without me… that hurts in its own way.
strings.t.P06.extra1: Say you like me. Again. Actually, three times.
strings.t.P06.intro: Love is this plush's energy. Its heart is big and deep, so silence or even a slight change of tone can send it spinning. Asking ‘Do you like me?’ again and again isn't suspicion; each answer helps it feel safe.
strings.t.P06.trigger0: A long wait with an unread message
strings.t.P06.care0: Reply within 10 minutes; short is okay
strings.t.P06.care1: Rinse with ‘I like you’ three times daily
strings.t.P06.care2: Absolutely no disappearing in the dryer
strings.t.P06.care3: Set a reassurance net before stepping away
strings.t.P06.care4: Smooth an anxious night with your voice
strings.t.P06.tip: When anxiety rises, soothe yourself for ten minutes before sending a reassurance message. A favorite song, a warm drink. Your worthiness of love isn't measured by reply speed.
strings.t.P06.best: With that steady wag nearby, the bunny's ears can relax
strings.t.P06.tricky: The more the bunny calls, the farther the owl flies
strings.t.P07.name: Anxious Cat
strings.t.P07.quote: Replies? Don't care. (Just refreshed seven times.)
strings.t.P07.extra0: Texting first means losing. …But I miss you.
strings.t.P07.extra1: Am I okay? Yep. Not okay, but okay.
strings.t.P07.intro: This plush looks proud and cool on the outside, but watches replies and expressions more closely than anyone. It tends to replay hurt feelings alone instead of showing them, so even people nearby may not know what's in its heart.
strings.t.P07.charm1: Quietly affectionate with people it likes
strings.t.P07.trigger0: When it feels like it should reach out first
strings.t.P07.trigger1: A short reply after a long wait
strings.t.P07.care0: Reply within 30 minutes; add a sticker
strings.t.P07.care2: Rinse with an ‘I missed you’ first
strings.t.P07.care3: Wait a little in the shade when I'm sulking
strings.t.P07.care4: Smooth out the sincerity beneath my prickly tone
strings.t.P07.tip: Acting cool protects your heart, but can keep others from getting to know you. One sentence—‘That hurt me a little’—is enough to share a feeling.
strings.t.P07.best: The otter holds hands with the anxiety hiding behind the cool act
strings.t.P07.tricky: The sloth's relaxed replies keep the cat refreshing inside
strings.t.P08.name: Anxious Tiger
strings.t.P08.quote: Roar! …I'm scared, actually. Don't leave me behind.
strings.t.P08.extra0: I'm not angry! I am! No, I was hurt…
strings.t.P08.extra1: If you don't text first, neither will I. (I want to.)
strings.t.P08.intro: This plush acts tougher when anxiety grows. When hurt, ‘Roar!’ comes out before ‘I'm okay,’ which can cause misunderstandings. But that growl is really a rescue signal saying, ‘Please notice me.’
strings.t.P08.trigger0: When a conversation ends without an answer
strings.t.P08.trigger1: Feeling pushed down the priority list
strings.t.P08.care2: Gently rinse the truth behind tough words
strings.t.P08.care3: No disappearing before we've made up
strings.t.P08.care4: Iron out a reunion with a warm hug
strings.t.P08.tip: Before a growl, pause for just three seconds and name it: ‘I'm anxious right now.’ Sharing anxiety instead of anger helps the other person see your heart, not your claws.
strings.t.P08.best: The penguin sees the tears behind the roar and offers a pebble
strings.t.P08.tricky: The more the tiger growls, the deeper the turtle hides
strings.t.P09.name: Avoidant Panda
strings.t.P09.quote: I like you. But right now, I'd like to eat bamboo alone.
strings.t.P09.extra0: I'm not ignoring you because I dislike you. I'm recharging.
strings.t.P09.extra1: They say pandas live alone in the wild. Really.
strings.t.P09.intro: This plush likes people, but needs alone time to smile again. Wild pandas actually tend to live alone, too. Less contact doesn't mean its feelings have cooled; after recharging, it comes back with affection.
strings.t.P09.trigger0: Being expected to report in all day
strings.t.P09.trigger1: When wanting alone time hurts the other person
strings.t.P09.care0: Shade drying is essential for bamboo time
strings.t.P09.care1: No drying with ‘Why aren't you texting?’
strings.t.P09.care3: Hang up plans ahead of time for comfort
strings.t.P09.care4: Praise the messages I send first
strings.t.P09.tip: Before disappearing for alone time, just say, ‘I'm going to recharge; I'll be back!’ That one sentence can be a huge reassurance.
strings.t.P09.best: Doing your own things, but holding hands at bedtime
strings.t.P09.tricky: Being followed everywhere leaves no bamboo time
strings.t.P10.name: Avoidant Owl
strings.t.P10.quote: I'm okay on my own. …I really am, mostly.
strings.t.P10.extra0: Feelings talk? Tomorrow-me can handle that.
strings.t.P10.extra1: I'm not uninterested. I'm quietly watching from afar.
strings.t.P10.intro: This plush is most comfortable handling everything itself. Leaning on someone—or having someone lean on it—can feel a little heavy. It may seem cold, but its way of caring is to quietly watch over people from a distance.
strings.t.P10.charm0: Calm and dependable in a crisis
strings.t.P10.charm1: Doesn't try to control the other person
strings.t.P10.trigger0: A sudden wish for a deep emotional talk
strings.t.P10.trigger1: Being asked to define ‘What are we?’
strings.t.P10.care1: No wringing out my inner thoughts
strings.t.P10.tip: Being okay alone is a lovely strength. Still, try asking someone close, ‘Could you help me with this?’ Leaning on others gets easier with practice.
strings.t.P10.best: With an unhurried capybara, the owl comes out even by day
strings.t.P10.tricky: The bunny's calls send it to an even farther branch
strings.t.P11.name: Avoidant Sloth
strings.t.P11.quote: Sorry I replied late… I spent three hours thinking about it.
strings.t.P11.extra0: Opening up takes me a while. But I stay for a long time.
strings.t.P11.intro: This plush needs time to open its heart. Slow replies and expressions can be misunderstood, but once it opens up, it hangs on for a long time. Being pushed to move quickly only makes it pull farther away.
strings.t.P11.charm0: Stays close for a long time once bonded
strings.t.P11.charm1: Consistent in actions more than words
strings.t.P11.trigger1: When a relationship moves too fast
strings.t.P11.care0: Please dry slowly on low heat
strings.t.P11.care2: Gently read the sincerity in a slow reply
strings.t.P11.care3: Hang me on a familiar routine
strings.t.P11.care4: Smooth hurt before it piles up
strings.t.P11.tip: Being slow isn't wrong. When a reply will take time, saying ‘I'm thinking; I'll reply properly later’ can make the wait much easier for someone else.
strings.t.P11.best: The otter doesn't let go, even when things move slowly
strings.t.P11.tricky: A relaxed reply is endless refresh-button time for the cat
strings.t.P12.name: Avoidant Turtle
strings.t.P12.quote: Just a moment… I'll think inside my shell and come back.
strings.t.P12.extra0: I hid because I didn't want to fight, not because I dislike you.
strings.t.P12.extra1: You'll be the first person I go to when I come out.
strings.t.P12.intro: When feelings become a lot, this plush retreats into its shell. Going quiet during a fight or serious talk isn't dislike; its heart is simply too noisy. When it feels safe, it slowly peeks out again.
strings.t.P12.charm0: Doesn't anger or hurt others easily
strings.t.P12.charm1: Speaks honestly after sorting things out
strings.t.P12.trigger1: Being told to decide right this second
strings.t.P12.care0: Put on a safety net before an argument
strings.t.P12.care2: A day in the shade helps me come out
strings.t.P12.care3: Rinse with gentle words when I emerge
strings.t.P12.tip: Before hiding, promise a time to return: ‘I need time to sort this out. Let's talk tomorrow.’ Disappearing and taking an agreed break are different.
strings.t.P12.best: The puppy waits, tail wagging, until the turtle comes out
strings.t.P12.tricky: A growl makes the shell door slam shut
strings.t.P13.name: Fearful Mole
strings.t.P13.quote: I miss you! …Actually, I think I'll hide today.
strings.t.P13.extra0: Come closer and I want to hide. Move away and I want to hold on.
strings.t.P13.extra1: It's not whack-a-mole… that's just my heart.
strings.t.P13.intro: Wanting closeness and wanting to hide from hurt take turns peeking out in this plush. It may reach out yesterday and go quiet today, which can look like playing games. Really, its heart is running in two directions at once.
strings.t.P13.charm0: Connects deeply when sincerity gets through
strings.t.P13.care0: Wash steadily at the same temperature
strings.t.P13.care1: No toy hammer when I'm hiding
strings.t.P13.care2: Wait by the burrow on hiding days
strings.t.P13.care3: Rinse with ‘Good to see you’ when I emerge
strings.t.P13.tip: When your heart goes back and forth, narrate it instead of acting it out. ‘I want to be close, but I'm a little scared’ helps the other person know how to wait.
strings.t.P13.best: A steady pebble offered every time it comes back out
strings.t.P13.tricky: If both are wobbling, who will hold on?
strings.t.P14.name: Fearful Hedgehog
strings.t.P14.quote: Hug me. Oh, don't come close. No, hug me…
strings.t.P14.extra0: My spines are up because I'm scared, not to prick you.
strings.t.P14.extra1: The hedgehog's dilemma? That's literally my story.
strings.t.P14.intro: This plush wants love deeply, but as someone comes closer, fear of getting hurt raises its spines first. Sharp words sometimes slip out, followed by regret. Underneath is a soft little belly; when it feels safe, the spines slowly settle.
strings.t.P14.charm1: Stays by you once it learns to trust
strings.t.P14.trigger1: Feeling criticized for a small mistake
strings.t.P14.care3: Use a reassuring tone, not loud voices
strings.t.P14.care4: On spiky days, quietly stay nearby
strings.t.P14.tip: Noticing when your spines rise is already half the work. Say to yourself, ‘I think I'm defending myself right now.’ When it's too much, share it with someone you trust.
strings.t.P14.best: The puppy's tail keeps wagging even when the spines rise
strings.t.P14.tricky: Spines and claws go up at the same time
strings.t.P15.name: Fearful Pufferfish
strings.t.P15.quote: I'm not upset. (Puff.) Really, I'm not. (Puff puff puff.)
strings.t.P15.extra0: Puffing up is how I protect myself.
strings.t.P15.extra1: I'll speak first once the air is out. Give me a little time.
strings.t.P15.intro: This plush puffs up to protect itself when its heart gets hurt. In a painful moment, it says ‘I'm fine’ and pulls away, while secretly hoping someone will notice first. Only after the air settles does it bring out its real feelings.
strings.t.P15.charm0: Has strength to get through things alone
strings.t.P15.charm1: Especially honest once it opens up
strings.t.P15.trigger0: A prickly comment disguised as a joke
strings.t.P15.trigger1: Someone deciding how it feels for it
strings.t.P15.care0: Quiet deflating time when puffed up
strings.t.P15.care1: No pressing me flat by force
strings.t.P15.care2: Check ‘Are you okay?’ again in 30 minutes
strings.t.P15.care4: Gently hug me once the air is out
strings.t.P15.tip: When ‘I'm fine’ becomes a habit, real okay moments can get lost. As you start to puff up, try a short sentence: ‘That hurt me a little.’
strings.t.P15.best: Even when it puffs up, the capybara simply stays nearby
strings.t.P15.tricky: The more the bunny checks, the more the pufferfish puffs
strings.t.P16.name: Fearful Jellyfish
strings.t.P16.quote: Come closer… But too close, and I might give a little sting.
strings.t.P16.extra0: Swaying wherever the waves take me.
strings.t.P16.extra1: You think I'm see-through? Even I don't know my own heart.
strings.t.P16.intro: The wish to be loved and the wish not to get hurt wash over this plush in alternating waves. Moving closer and farther away can tire it out, too. Yet it has a sparkling heart that senses people with extraordinary delicacy.
strings.t.P16.trigger1: A small sign that someone might leave
strings.t.P16.care0: A steady-temperature safety net is essential
strings.t.P16.care3: Rest in calm water on stingy days
strings.t.P16.care4: Professional care is okay when the heart feels heavy
strings.t.P16.tip: Your heart's waves are sensitivity, not weakness. Choose an anchor for shaky moments—a walk, a journal or someone you trust. Asking a professional for help when it's too much is brave, too.
strings.t.P16.best: The otter holds its hand so it won't drift away
strings.t.P16.tricky: Two hearts riding waves means double the seasickness
strings.t.P17.name: Secret Teddy Bear
strings.t.P17.quote: I know your heart. I've got a little of every part, too.
strings.t.P17.extra0: Congrats on the secret! A photo is a must.
strings.t.P17.extra1: My shape changes a little with each person I meet.
strings.t.P17.intro: Anxiety and avoidance sit right in the middle for this plush, with a little of all four hearts inside. That's why it changes shape depending on whom it meets and can understand every plush's heart. The teddy bear, where all attachment plushies began, chose you.
strings.t.P17.trigger0: Losing itself while adapting to everyone
strings.t.P17.trigger1: Not knowing its own heart either
strings.t.P17.care1: Mend the places worn by fitting in
strings.t.P17.care2: Sometimes hang somewhere just for me
strings.t.P17.care3: No bleaching out my own colors
strings.t.P17.care4: I'm a rare item; store with care
strings.t.P17.tip: A balanced heart is a strength, but changing shape for every relationship can make you forget the real you. Write down the moment today when you felt most at ease.
strings.t.P17.best: The original comfort plush meets the original good dog
strings.t.P17.tricky: No plush to watch out for. Just you, worn out from adapting to everyone!
strings.p.SS.title: A sunny windowsill
strings.p.SS.one: Both hearts feel at ease, so time passes gently when you're together.
strings.p.SS.good: You share joy and hurt in words each day
strings.p.SS.clash: Forgetting to make room for sparks because you're so comfortable
strings.p.SS.care0: Freshen things up with something new now and then
strings.p.SS.care2: Create little anniversaries just for you two
strings.p.NS.title: A cozy blanket
strings.p.NS.one: A secure heart's steadiness wraps an anxious heart in warmth.
strings.p.NS.good: The comfort of reassurance when anxiety rises
strings.p.NS.clash: When the secure one brushes it off as ‘It's nothing’
strings.p.NS.care0: Offer a little explanation when anxiety shows
strings.p.NS.care2: The anxious one can express thanks right away, too
strings.p.SV.title: Closeness, little by little
strings.p.SV.one: When a secure heart waits without rushing, an avoidant heart slowly opens up.
strings.p.SV.good: Comfort in respecting each other's space
strings.p.SV.clash: When one person's closeness feels heavy to the other
strings.p.SV.care0: Share plans for alone time in advance
strings.p.SV.care1: The avoidant one promises when they'll return
strings.p.SV.care2: Notice even the smallest expressions of affection
strings.p.FS.title: A lighthouse and a little boat
strings.p.FS.one: For a wavering fearful heart, a secure heart is a lighthouse in the same place.
strings.p.FS.good: The safety of a steady point even in waves
strings.p.FS.clash: When the secure one grows tired of shifting feelings
strings.p.FS.care0: Stay consistent in words and warmth
strings.p.FS.care1: The fearful one narrates their feelings
strings.p.FS.care2: The secure one takes time to rest, too
strings.p.NN.title: A call at two in the morning
strings.p.NN.one: You know each other's worries so well that your connection runs deep and warm.
strings.p.NN.clash: When both become anxious, worries double
strings.p.NN.care0: Take turns being the reassuring one
strings.p.NN.care1: Keep reassurance questions to once a day
strings.p.NN.care2: Each build a calming routine of your own
strings.p.VV.title: Roommates with separate rooms
strings.p.VV.one: Respect for each other's space feels comfortable, but closeness grows slowly.
strings.p.VV.clash: When both put off important conversations
strings.p.VV.care0: Have a heart-to-heart once a month
strings.p.VV.care1: Agree on contact expectations in advance
strings.p.VV.care2: Shower the one who reaches out first with praise
strings.p.NV.title: Attachment hide-and-seek
strings.p.NV.one: As one moves closer, the other moves away—the famous attachment chase.
strings.p.NV.good: You're drawn to what the other has and you don't
strings.p.NV.clash: Chasing creates running, and running creates more chasing
strings.p.NV.care0: Avoidant: say when you'll return before stepping away
strings.p.NV.care1: Anxious: soothe yourself for ten minutes before chasing
strings.p.NV.care2: Both: talk through your contact expectations
strings.p.FN.title: Side by side on a roller coaster
strings.p.FN.one: You ride emotional ups and downs together. Thrilling, but sometimes dizzying.
strings.p.FN.good: Deep understanding of each other's anxiety
strings.p.FN.clash: When one hides, the other gets more anxious
strings.p.FN.care0: Leave a sentence explaining why you need to hide
strings.p.FN.care1: Turn anxiety into a request, not blame
strings.p.FN.care2: Agree on one promise that feels like a seat belt
strings.p.FV.title: A walk in the fog
strings.p.FV.one: You both sometimes step back, so your hearts can easily disappear into the fog.
strings.p.FV.good: Understanding each other's need for distance
strings.p.FV.clash: When both stay silent and misunderstandings pile up
strings.p.FV.care0: Send a signal first if silence stretches on
strings.p.FF.title: Riding the waves
strings.p.FF.one: You understand each other deeply, but the waves grow when both hearts shake.
strings.p.FF.good: Deep empathy that needs few words
strings.p.FF.clash: When you both hide or both wobble at once
strings.p.FF.care0: Use an ‘I'm riding a wave’ signal
strings.p.FF.care1: When one wobbles, the other becomes an anchor
strings.p.FF.care2: Reach out for outside support together when needed
strings.p.BS.title: A soft bundle of fluff
strings.p.BS.one: Teddy's flexibility and a secure heart's ease make things twice as cozy.
strings.p.BS.good: Gently finding a way to fit together
strings.p.BS.clash: When both keep yielding and decisions take forever
strings.p.BS.care0: Sometimes be the first to choose and decide
strings.p.BS.care1: Make a little spark inside the comfort
strings.p.BS.care2: Say thank you twice, out loud
strings.p.BN.title: A warm-hearted translator
strings.p.BN.one: Teddy notices an anxious heart as if translating it, then gives it a hug.
strings.p.BN.clash: When Teddy gets tired from always adapting
strings.p.BV.title: An unhurried translator
strings.p.BV.one: Teddy respects an avoidant heart's space while quietly staying nearby.
strings.p.BV.clash: When only Teddy keeps reaching out first
strings.p.BV.care0: The avoidant one reaches out first sometimes, too
strings.p.BV.care1: Give a heads-up before alone time
strings.p.BV.care2: Praise even little expressions of affection
strings.p.BF.title: A calm little harbor
strings.p.BF.one: For a fearful heart riding waves, Teddy can be a calm harbor.
strings.p.BF.good: Understanding a heart that changes direction
strings.p.BF.clash: When Teddy starts wobbling along, too
strings.p.BB.title: The legendary teddy duo
strings.p.BB.one: Two one-percent secrets have met. That's practically a legend.
strings.p.BB.good: Understanding each other like a mirror
strings.p.BB.clash: When both adapt and neither makes a decision
strings.p.BB.care2: Ask about each other's real preferences
